versions.content: When called by its users (e.g. RTE, SwCluC LdCom Proxy), LdCom shall use the Signal Id ("id" parameter in the call) as LdComHandleId ( ECUC_LdCom_00005 ), to look - up the correct LdComIPdu in the LdCom configuration. Using the LdComPduRef configuration parameter ( ECUC_LdCom_00010 ) the co rresponding PDU Id in the PduR'S configuration shall be derived. This PDU Id shall then be used when forwarding the call towards the PduR.
